other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Proposed 1 MW Combined Heat Power (cogeneration) unit within the sports-complex microgrid, generating electricity and thermal energy
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: Installation of 1 MW Combined Heat Power (CHP)

one_line: The paper designs and evaluates a microgrid (PV, BESS, CHP, backup gensets) to minimize grid energy imports for the Olympic Athletic Center of Athens sports complex — a large-scale building/facility energy context, not continuous-flow industrial production.
